newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian avg money market rate edges up to 8.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian avg money market rate edges up to 8.6 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate edged up to 8.6 percent on Monday from 8.5 percent, despite much stronger interbank demand.
Trade volume rose to 127 million kuna from Thursday's 55 million with fresh deals accounting for 108.9 million kuna.
Call money granted at a higher 8.0 made up most of the new borrowings.
Interbank term rates were also slightly firmer with 8.5-10 percent charged for up to 11-day deals. Longer-term rates ranged between 15 percent for two-week and 18 for two-month kuna.
Insurers rolled over one-week loans at a steady 7.0 percent and 30-day loans at 13.5 percent.
The central bank's kuna midrates were calculated firmer at 6.4502 against the dollar and weaker at 3.5615 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb newsroom 385-1-4557075
